name: Hot leads or ghosts?
text: Are you getting hot leads — or are you just collecting email addresses that ghost you the moment you follow up?

name: Growing or grinding?
text: Is your business actually growing — or are you just grinding harder every month to hit the same number?

name: Serving or selling?
text: Are you serving your people — or just selling at them until they tune you out?

name: Leads coming in or leaking out?
text: Are your leads coming in — or are they quietly leaking out between the ad and the offer?

name: System or memory?
text: Is your follow-up a system — or just you remembering to text people back?

name: Community or audience?
text: Do you have a community — or do you just have an audience?

name: Pipeline or guessing game?
text: Do you have a sales pipeline — or is every launch a guessing game?

name: Content or conversion?
text: Are you creating content that converts — or are you just posting more into the void and hoping something lands?

name: Launching or hoping?
text: Do you have a launch playbook — or are you just hoping this one hits different?

name: Scaling or surviving?
text: Are you actually scaling — or are you just surviving another month on the hustle that built this?

name: Audience or assets?
text: Do you own your audience — or do you just rent attention on platforms that could change the rules tomorrow?

name: Serving fans or selling strangers?
text: Are you serving fans who already trust you — or still trying to sell strangers who barely know your name?

name: Funnels or friction?
text: Do you have a funnel — or just a bunch of friction points dressed up in fancy software?

name: Trusted or tolerated?
text: Is your list waiting to hear from you — or just tolerating your emails until they unsubscribe?

name: Business or demanding job?
text: Is what you've built actually a business — or is it a very demanding job that only works when you show up?

name: Architected or assembled?
text: Is your business architected — or just assembled from whatever tools you bought along the way?

name: Converting or collecting?
text: Are your webinars actually converting — or are they just collecting people who sign up, never show up, and never buy?
